newsitem.title: CHINA: Moody's affirms rating for Boston-based EIF.
newsitem.headline: Moody's affirms rating for Boston-based EIF.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it had affirmed the Ba1 rating with a negative outlook on the senior secured US$125 million bond issued by Boston-based Energy Investors Fund Funding Corp.

But the rating outlook could improve to stable if and when the announced buyout settlement from Niagara Mohawk Corp, which has a senior secured debt rating of Ba3, was approved by all necessary regulatory authorities and appropriately funded, it said.
EIF has five projects in its portfolio that currently have long- term contracts to sell electricity to Niagara Mohawk.
EIF expected to receive additional cash payments from one project involved in the buyout settlement that would be applied to further debt reduction, Moody's said.
